provenance.disclaimer_vi: Dữ liệu tổng hợp mô phỏng hành vi người dùng, không phải dữ liệu thu thập từ người dùng thực tế.
provenance.disclaimer_en: Synthetic data from a behavioural simulation. Not collected from real users.

protocol.demand_source: pilot run of the synthetic simulator with unlimited stock (uncensored borrow requests); same seed as the observed dataset
protocol.inventory_model: circulating copies: a served borrow holds one copy until the loan return day; purchases add copies permanently; unmet requests are lost
protocol.inventory_position: shelf copies + copies on order (copies on loan excluded, as in production available_qty)
protocol.budget_rule: per review = min(total cost of REORDER_POINT, total cost of MA30_FIXED_LT) / number of reviews, same scenario

scenarios.description: Calibrated starting collection, every order delivered after 14 days.
Calibrated starting collection, each order delivered after 14-28 days (supplier slower than its declared 14 days).
Half of the calibrated starting collection (at least 1 copy), 14-day delivery.
